newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Illinois Central EPS estimate up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Illinois Central EPS estimate up.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Steve Lewins said Thursday he raised his 1997 earnings estimate for Illinois Central Corp to $2.55 from $2.45, to reflect $0.10 to $0.20 of earnings from the Chicago, Central & Pacific acquisition.

-- "We are not revising our conservative 1996 estimate (of $2.15 a share) until we see grain moving again, which seems likely but not certain due to recent mergers and shifting grain movement patterns," Lewins wrote in a report.
-- He added the third quarter estimate remains $0.50 a share versus $0.54.
-- He added Illinois Central's traffic for the third quarter is projected to be flat, based on a 13 percent rise in in coal and a 47 percent in long-haul grain movements.
-- Illinois Central shares were down 1/8 at 31-1/4.
